data.name: Holy Crap
data.detailed_description:
HOLY CRAP is a dark comedy narrative experience about faith, power, media manipulation, and collective hypocrisy. You play through cinematic chapters where each scenario pushes you into morally uncomfortable decisions. Your choices affect how people react, how conflicts escalate, and how the story unfolds.

Key Features

  • Choice-driven storytelling

Make decisions in high-tension scenes and deal with the fallout.

Dark comedy + social satire

Serious topics are explored through irony, absurdity, and provocative humor.

  • Cinematic chapter structure

Progress through story episodes with distinct themes, characters, and consequences.

  • Branching outcomes

Different reactions and narrative variations based on your behavior and priorities.

  • Single-player narrative focus

Designed as a story-first experience with replay value through alternate choices.

Content Notes

The game includes stylized depictions of violence, disturbing situations, and mature social themes. It is designed to provoke reflection while still being entertaining and funny.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: no
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400F / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12

  • VR Support: no

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes stylized depictions of blood, injuries, and dead bodies in some narrative/cinematic sequences. It also contains themes related to religion, social manipulation, and psychological distress.

There is no explicit sexual content, no nudity, and no gambling. Violence is not realistic simulation-focused, but some scenes may be disturbing for sensitive audiences.
